## App Configuration (AC)

Id pattern + mint counter, default SLA Window, integrations, automation policies, and the Setup Wizard's resume point (`setupStep`) + `setupCompletedAt`. App-agnostic: a billing desk keeps its settings in the same shape.

### Non-goals

Not realm config and not per-user preferences — desk-level, one per app instance.

cardInfo.name: App Configuration
cardInfo.summary: The bag of desk-level settings an app card carries once.

attributes.cardDescription: One app instance's settings: the record-id pattern and counter, a default SLA window, its integrations and automation policies, and where the setup wizard left off.
